nodes.label: ONIRIA Brand Mark (geometric rosette / mandala of overlapping arcs around a central circle, sky blue #62a5f0 on near-black #020305)
nodes.norm_label: oniria brand mark (geometric rosette / mandala of overlapping arcs around a central circle, sky blue #62a5f0 on near-black #020305)
nodes.rationale: Single SVG asset serves as navbar logo, footer logo and site favicon, so one file carries the whole brand identity; it is an auto-traced raster (many near-duplicate blue fills), which is why it is heavy for an icon and is served with a one-year immutable cache.

nodes.rationale: Hero visual communicates the product pitch at a glance: a customer message arriving on WhatsApp is processed by an AI and automatically routed to CRM, analytics and email, so the visitor understands the automation value without reading copy.

nodes.label: Dark Glassmorphism Neon-Purple Visual Style
nodes.rationale: Near-black background, blurred purple orbs, rounded glass tiles with gradient borders and glowing connector lines with travelling dots suggest data in motion and a modern AI/tech brand.

nodes.label: Dependabot config
nodes.rationale: Monthly and grouped so each ecosystem produces one PR that the CI gate checks in a single run rather than a stream of individual bumps.

nodes.label: CI / Quality Checks job (lint, typecheck, build)
nodes.norm_label: ci / quality checks job (lint, typecheck, build)
nodes.rationale: Catches build breaks on the PR before Vercel ever builds main. Frozen-lockfile install also fails if pnpm-lock.yaml is out of sync. pnpm version is resolved from package.json packageManager; Node from .nvmrc.

nodes.label: Deploy to self-hosted VPS (manual) workflow
nodes.rationale: Manual only. Production is Vercel; this keeps the Docker + Cloudflare Tunnel path runnable if the project ever moves hosts. Requires DEPLOY_* secrets and a server .env with CLOUDFLARE_TUNNEL_TOKEN.

nodes.label: Deploy to VPS job (SSH, confirm-gated)
nodes.rationale: Builds the new image first so the old stack keeps serving during the build; downtime is only the container swap. Only changed services are recreated so the tunnel stays connected.

nodes.label: Deploy health wait loop (docker inspect oniria-web)
nodes.norm_label: deploy health wait loop (docker inspect oniria-web)
nodes.rationale: Waits for the container to report healthy rather than guessing with a fixed sleep; fails the deploy and prints logs otherwise.

nodes.label: Project-scoped image prune (label com.oniria.project=webpage)
nodes.rationale: Reclaims the superseded image, scoped to this project so other stacks on the host are untouched.

nodes.label: cloudflared service (oniria-tunnel, Cloudflare Tunnel)
nodes.rationale: TUNNEL_TOKEN is read from the .env next to the compose file (compose does not interpolate from .env.local) or the deploy shell; hard-fails if CLOUDFLARE_TUNNEL_TOKEN is unset. Starts only once web is healthy.

nodes.label: web service (oniria-web container, 127.0.0.1:3000)
nodes.rationale: Build label com.oniria.project=webpage lets the deploy prune only this project's superseded images. Port bound to loopback only; public access goes through the tunnel.

nodes.label: Cloudflare DNS-only mode (grey cloud)
nodes.rationale: Cloudflare does not proxy this site, so caching and TLS are Vercel's.

nodes.label: Development setup (Node 22 via .nvmrc, pnpm via corepack)
nodes.norm_label: development setup (node 22 via .nvmrc, pnpm via corepack)

nodes.label: Environment variables N8N_HMAC_SECRET and N8N_WEBHOOK_URL
nodes.rationale: Must be set for Production and Preview in Vercel; without the Preview values the contact form fails on preview deployments.

nodes.label: Rollback via Vercel Instant Rollback
nodes.rationale: No git revert needed.

nodes.label: Tech stack: Next.js, shadcn/ui, Motion, next-intl
nodes.norm_label: tech stack: next.js, shadcn/ui, motion, next-intl

nodes.label: Vercel production deployment from main
nodes.rationale: Production is Vercel, deployed automatically from main by the GitHub integration to www.oniriasolutions.com. CI / Quality Checks is a required check, so a red build blocks the merge; pushing straight to main bypasses it.

nodes.label: CI concurrency policy (cancel superseded branch runs, never main)
nodes.norm_label: ci concurrency policy (cancel superseded branch runs, never main)
nodes.rationale: Superseded pushes on a feature branch are cancelled; runs on main are never cancelled so there is always a complete record of what landed.

nodes.label: Build needs no env (N8N vars read inside server action body)
nodes.norm_label: build needs no env (n8n vars read inside server action body)
nodes.rationale: Both N8N_* vars are read inside the server action body (submit-contact.tsx:11-12), never at module scope, so the build does not evaluate them.

nodes.label: Self-hosting escape hatch (Docker + Cloudflare Tunnel on VPS)
nodes.norm_label: self-hosting escape hatch (docker + cloudflare tunnel on vps)
nodes.rationale: workflow_dispatch-only and not part of normal deploys; needs DEPLOY_* secrets and a server .env holding CLOUDFLARE_TUNNEL_TOKEN.
